Representative Expo Router app root for the MTS-003 correction round.

This fixture is test-only, non-product, and non-routable. It models the
approved future shape of apps/mobile/app: the permanent (tabs) group keeps
exactly the four approved routes while an additional non-tab root route group
stands in for the full-screen modal routes that a later ticket adds.

The permanent tab inventory must remain protected; the extra root group must
not, merely by existing, fail the MTS-003 permanent-tab contract.
